system.description: You command a summoned or otherworldly creature within 30', such as a Fiend, a Fey or a summoned minion, to begone.

outcomes.triumph: The creature screams as it vanishes, and cannot return until the next day begins. A Strong or Mighty creature takes 2x damage instead.
outcomes.ruin: The entity notices you: its next gloom ability targets you if it can. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
